Hi Karen —

Thanks for the clear examples — helpful. Short answers up front: portal preferred, email fallback allowed with guidelines, PO number in a consistent field is required for automation. Details below and next steps at the bottom.

Portal vs email
- Preferred: Vendor Portal (https://vendors.redwood.com) — supports structured upload (CSV/Excel), auto-ack, and PO matching.
- Fallback: invoices to invoices@redwood.com are accepted if portal is unavailable. Use the template/filename rules below to avoid manual routing.

Template & filename rules (for email fallback)
- Subject line MUST contain: PO#<PO_NUMBER> (e.g., PO#123456) OR Invoice: PO#123456
- Filename should include vendor name and invoice date, e.g., AcmeSupplies_20280528_INV123.pdf
- PDF must show PO number in header or invoice meta (line item-level PO matching is supported but not required).

PO stamping
- Visible PO stamp on PDF is preferred but not mandatory. If you cannot stamp, ensure a clear PO number field on the invoice (top right preferred).

Attachments & data elements we need (minimal set for automation)
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- PO number (exact match)
- Line items with quantities/unit prices OR a single line summary with total
- Billing address + remit instructions (for routing/ledger)

Next steps
1) I've attached our vendor onboarding form for any missing fields — please return the signed copy.
2) Marissa (AP) will share the email-fallback acceptance SLA and the small sample CSV we use for portal ingestion.
3) Karthik will follow up on SFTP options if you prefer batch drops vs. manual portal uploads.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in for AP SLA & technical options.

Best,

Quick technical notes from infra/ingest perspective (cc'ing AP):

- Portal: supports Excel (XLSX) and CSV templates. For high-volume vendors we can set up a dedicated vendor folder and auto-insert invoices into the queue.
- Email ingest: we parse subject and filenames; our parser looks for /PO#(\d+)/ by default. If Acme would prefer a different token, we can add a whitelist mapping on onboarding.
- SFTP/S3: supported. If Acme wants scheduled batch pushes, we'll provide SFTP credentials and a landing-prefix.
- Common failure modes: scans with poor OCR, missing PO, or multi-PO invoices (we can accept multiple PO lines but need an explicit PO per invoice for auto-match).

Suggested filename convention example for automated handling:
AcmeSupplies_PO123456_INV20280528.pdf

I'll prepare the short ingest spec and sample CSV and share to the Drive link Vanessa included.

— Karthik

Hi Karen —

All good on your two points: native PDFs are preferred (less OCR errors) but scanned PDFs that clearly show invoice fields are acceptable. PO in the invoice header is fine — visible stamp not required.

Exception handling (what happens if auto-match fails)
- Failure queue: invoice routes to AP exceptions inbox. We attempt 1 automated match, then flag for manual review.
- SLA: standard turnaround for exceptions is 3 business days; if the PO is valid but missing data we'll create an action ticket and notify vendor with steps to re-submit.
- Contact: marissa_cole@redwood.com (AP Specialist) — she'll be triage lead for the first 30 days of go-live.

Final checklist for Acme to share with AP:
- Preferred: upload to vendor portal (XLSX or CSV for bulk).
- Email fallback: send to invoices@redwood.com with Subject containing PO#123456 and filename including vendor/invoice/date.
- Required fields on invoice: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, total, remit account.
- If sending batches via SFTP, request credentials from karthik_iyer@redwood.com and reference folder prefix: acme/production/.

2) Marissa — please send the email-fallback SLA and the AP exception ticket template to Karen (cc'd).
3) Karthik — drop the ingest spec and sample CSV to the Drive link and confirm SFTP timelines if Acme requests it.
